big3.headline: The U.S. government now calls AI “Super Intelligence”
big3.what_happened: On Sep 29, a White House order told federal agencies to use “Super Intelligence” (SI) instead of “AI”. Six top AI companies also signed a voluntary safety accord that day.
big3.why_it_matters: Expect “SI” in federal bids and documents. The accord asks AI makers for outside safety audits, and on Oct 4 the President named a federal AI task force.

big3.headline: OpenAI cuts the price of near-top AI to one-fifth
big3.what_happened: On Sep 29, OpenAI released GPT‑6.1 Sol. OpenAI says it is almost as capable as its top model, GPT‑6 Astra, at one-fifth of the standard price.
big3.why_it_matters: Lower prices make AI cheaper to use for routine office work, such as reports, documents and spreadsheets.

big3.headline: Google puts its AI chips into orbit to test data centers in space
big3.what_happened: On Oct 1, Google and Planet launched a test satellite with Google AI chips on a SpaceX rocket. Google says it works as expected.
big3.why_it_matters: This is an early research step. Google wants to learn if space can one day hold large AI computer systems.

projects.name: Zone Frontier campus

scoreboard.intro: A benchmark is a fixed test that compares AI models. Last checked Oct 5, 2026. Words in brackets, such as High or Max, show how long a model can think before it answers.

headline.title: Gemini 4 Argon is the new No. 1 on LMArena
headline.after: leaderboard is now Gemini 4 Argon (High). It is tagged Preliminary on the live board (Style Control on). People vote for the better of two answers, and the votes give each model a score.
headline.detail: It has 1525 points, 20 more than No. 2, Claude Opus 4.6 (High).
